title: offlineModule
responsibility: Define scoped streamed downloads, durable mutation replay, offline collections and their verification scaffolds.

outputs.name: offlineModule
outputs.description: The exported offlineModule definition supplies the app-only Offline module's service and endpoint templates, collection scaffold, dependencies, and setup guidance. It is version 1.0.0; its generated endpoint limits request bodies to 65,536 bytes and downloads to 32 collections, 4 MiB per frame, and 8 MiB per batch.

examples.title: Offline
examples.description: Background data streaming, scoped device storage and durable queued writes.
instructions: References: Fluora uses @dafuga01/offline-sync for IndexedDB and durable replay; BuildFlexity uses scoped incremental download batches.

instructions: Generate a collection and register its kebab-case name in the client allowed collections and authenticated server adapters.
